about: Sizes of the display-only layers over the native model (terminations, resistor overcoat, solder joints and via tents): lengths in mm, shares as fractions. They are drawn, never saved. Sources are in docs/materials.md; est. marks an estimate.

termination_growth_mm.note: Termination plating beyond the body faces (real terminations are 10-30 um).

chip_band_share.note: A chip termination's band on the top face: a fifth of the length (EIA chip-resistor bands are 0.3-0.5 mm from 0603 to 1206).

chip_band_max_mm.note: A chip termination's band is at most 0.5 mm (EIA chip-resistor bands are 0.3-0.5 mm from 0603 to 1206).

lead_band_height_share.note: Height share of a non-chip lead band (est.).

overcoat_inset_mm.note: The resistor overcoat stops this far short of the body's long edges, leaving a white alumina rim (est.).

overcoat_mm.note: The resistor overcoat stands this far above the body (est.).

fillet_height_share.note: Solder fillet height as a share of the body height (J-STD-001 asks for at least a quarter of the termination height).

fillet_max_mm.note: A chip's solder fillet is at most this high (est.).

fillet_width_share.note: The fillet is narrower than the termination it wets (est.).

fillet_min_toe_mm.note: Pads reaching less than this beyond the termination get no fillet (est.).

foot_toe_share.note: A gull-wing foot's toe fillet climbs its end face to this share of the lead thickness (est.).

foot_heel_share.note: A gull-wing foot's heel fillet climbs to this share of the lead thickness (IPC J-STD-001 asks for a heel fillet of at least the lead thickness).

pin_land_share.note: A header pin's solder cone covers this share of its land's radius (est.).

pin_rise_share.note: A header pin's solder cone climbs the pin by this share of the land beyond the pin, plus half the pin side (est.).

pin_rise_max_mm.note: A header pin's solder cone climbs at most this far (est.).

tent_sag_mm.note: A tented via's mask sags this far into the drill it bridges (est.; LPI tents over a 0.3 mm hole dip into it as a visible dimple). 8 um read as no dimple in the look review. The dimple stays clear above the copper under the mask, so a track ending at the via never shows through it.

tent_skirt_mm.note: How far past the ring the tent's dome slopes down into the mask (est.).
